summary: Join our ArcGIS and QGIS training course to learn effective geospatial data visualization. Transform your data into insightful maps and analyses!
lede: Geospatial data visualization helps professionals turn location-based data into clear maps and dashboards for reporting and decisions. Designed for analysts, planners, program teams and others who need to interpret and communicate spatial information, it covers preparing spatial data, selecting map types and classification methods, and building report-ready layouts, web maps and interactive dashboards with ArcGIS and QGIS.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly need to interpret, map, and communicate location-based data.
audience: Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL/M&E) professionals
modules: Principles of Geospatial Visualization and Map Thinking
Getting Started with ArcGIS and QGIS Interfaces
Symbology and Classification That Tells the Truth
Labels, Annotations, and Readable Map Design
Visualizing Change Over Time and Comparisons
Story Maps and Spatial Data Storytelling
Quality Control, Ethics, and Visualization Pitfalls
prerequisites: Basic understanding of GIS concepts and familiarity with data analysis. Access to ArcGIS and QGIS software is recommended.
